paragraphs: The F-Type SVR uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 that sits at the top of Jaguar's performance range. It was fitted from 2013 through to the end of the X152 generation's production in 2024, and represents the most powerful engine option offered in the F-Type line-up. The AJ133 is a well-documented engine in Jaguar circles, with timing chain tensioner design being the primary area of attention across the engine family.

cards.body: A 5.0L V8 Petrol Supercharged engine fitted to the F-Type SVR — X152 (2013–2024).
